review.posthog_relevance: Updates Slack App workflow identifiers and compatibility handling for Slack mention processing, ensuring the workflow engine correctly dispatches and recognizes Slack-related background jobs.
review.reason: The change updates workflow ID prefixes and compatibility checks for Slack mention processing workflows. P1.F2.H1 establishes the new ID prefix, P1.F1.H1 applies it to workflow dispatch, and P1.F3.H4 adds compatibility checks to reconstruct legacy IDs. This represents a substantive, bounded correctness and compatibility improvement for the Slack App integration, warranting a score
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the presence of compatibility and correctness changes, but the actual runtime benefit and complete implementation of compatibility handling are not fully demonstrated. No tier assignment performed.
